_comment: Copy this file to deploy.local.json and fill in your values, then run:
deploy.local.json is git-ignored. Phone numbers and addresses do not belong in source
(CLAUDE.md §0.5), which is the whole reason this file exists.
Every key is OPTIONAL. A missing one falls back to the template default, which for the
tester console means 'not configured yet' — the component still deploys and fails closed
No secrets here, ever. The admin password and the call dispatch token live in Secrets
Manager and are read by the Lambda at runtime; they are never passed as parameters.
